description: Execute the provider selected by a prior ATL Decision. ATL validates the execution authorization, executes the selected provider, may use bounded fallback, and automatically records the execution Outcome.

decision_reference.description: ATL decision ID returned by the prior atl_decide call.

input.description: Task input to send to the ATL-selected provider.

outcome_correlation_token.description: ATL token returned with the prior decision to authorize this execution.

tenant_scope.description: Optional tenant scope for the execution authorization.

name: atl_execute
